metadata.title: Online Digital Newspaper Sources - James Tanner
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription:
Learn how to enhance your genealogy research using newspapers.
For information on upcoming webinars go to: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/all-webinars/introduction-to-the-familysearch-app-gallery
Follow the links to view the websites mentioned during the presentation:
https://www.myheritage.com/
http://newspaperarchive.com/
https://www.elephind.com/
http://trove.nla.gov.au/
http://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/
http://genealogysstar.blogspot.com/2014/07/online-digital-newspaper-collections-by.html
